description: An `<md>` inside a markup value in an expression is not read by impl#1 yet and is refused by name (E-MD-IN-LOGIC-NOMINAL) instead of rendering its markdown source inside an unknown element.
provenance: PA reading, s462-md-phase2 (§67.2 Where impl#1 reads it)
rationale: §67.2: a static `<md>` is read in every markup body; inside `lift` markup or a markup value in an expression impl#1 refuses it with E-MD-IN-LOGIC-NOMINAL (Nominal in that position) — never a silent render of the markdown source.
